title: Patriot Day.
bodyText: September eleventh shall be known and designated as "Patriot Day". This day shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-3.5]  Patriot Day.  September eleventh shall be known and designated as "Patriot Day".  This day shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2009, c 14, §2]
